name: dell_scaling_in_zh
text:
丰富：
$DELL - 每周 - $3.50 - $530 看涨期权

现在以1%的比例逐步增加……希望能便宜一点

@everyone $alert
note: 8/10 头号漏单：字段分隔符写法 '$TICKER - weekly - $喊价 - $行权价 calls'。'$3.50 - $530' 逐字命中 PRICE_RANGE_PATTERN 被当喊价区间跳过，中英双跳且零 TG。修在 _INVERTED_PRICE_STRIKE_RE 的分隔符（\s+ → [\s\-–—]+）—— 归一化跑在区间 pre-filter 之前，改写成规范序后区间正则自然不再命中

name: dell_chop_in_half_zh
note: 同夜的平仓喊话（收盘前 3 分钟）。ZH '削减一半' 与 EN 'chopping in half' 都不在动词表，双语双漏、日志实证走了 OPEN 侧 Parse failed。当晚零损失（无 DELL 持仓），但与上面两行**耦合**：修了开仓不修平仓 = 买得进卖不出，该标的当日收盘 -52%

name: dell_chop_in_half_en
note: EN 孪生。pct 必须是 50 不是 33（'chopping in half'）也不是 1（'1% lotto position' 是仓位标注不是 trim 比例，见 PCT_PATTERN 的 _PCT_SIZE_ADJ）—— 双语 pct 不一致时谁先到按谁执行，是隐性错平

name: uber_holding_en
note: 持仓状态贴，主动 skip 正确。同时钉住 8/10 新增的 skip 告警闸不会对它发 TG（三件套缺 calls/puts 方向词）

name: uber_holding_zh
note: ZH 孪生走 parse 失败而非 skip（'持有我的30%' 不在 skip 关键词表）—— 行为不同但结果同样是不下单不告警

name: close_recap_choppier_en
text:
enrich:
At close for me:

$UBER 465%
$NOW 1%
$DELL -52% 

Today was a choppier day, but nothing we can’t learn from and improve on.

After the $UBER gap up this morning, I thought we were all in a pretty good spot, but reading through the chats, it sounds like some people were oversized on the other trades.

The biggest takeaway is risk management. One day should never be able to erase weeks of progress or put a meaningful dent in your account. Size accordingly, stay disciplined, and give yourself the ability to come back tomorrow with a clear head and plenty of capital.

We have an incredible amount of opportunity ahead of us. Days like today are where we sharpen execution, identify what needs improvement, and come back better. Keep your heads up.

@everyone $alert
note: 收盘复盘。**chop 家族的关键负例**：'Today was a choppier day' 必须留在 OPEN 侧——_CHOP_HALF_PATTERN 强制要求 'in half'，裸 chop/choppy 是横盘黑话不是平仓指令
